title: Justification
definition: Justification is God's declaration that a sinner is righteous before Him through faith in Jesus Christ.
summary: Justification is not God pretending sinners are righteous. It is God's legal declaration based on the righteousness and sacrifice of Christ.
christFocus: Believers are justified by Christ's righteousness credited to them through faith.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Justification is not God pretending sinners are righteous. It is God's legal declaration based on the righteousness and sacrifice of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
